<div class="card-body">
'''Vader's Eye''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーの目</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ベイダーが特定の位置カードで単独で戦闘を防衛している時に使う。戦闘力を＋１し、戦闘運命数を１回加えることができる。２：その他の能力値＞２の帝国軍が特定の位置カード上で、単独で戦闘を防衛している場合に、戦闘運命数を１回加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-277o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">装甲マスクと生命維持システムで完全防備のダース・ベイダーは、そのダーク・ジェダイの技とあいまって、決闘や戦闘では脅威的な防御力を発揮する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Vader's Eye.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use when Vader is defending alone at a site. You may add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. 2. If another Imperial with ability greater than 2 is defending alone at a site, you may add one battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Darth Vader's armored mask and life support protect him fully. Combined with his Dark Jedi skills, they give him formidable defenses in duels and battles.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Eye]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
